name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: In Stormwind, the search for the missing diplomat brings you face to face with Dashel Stonefist in Old Town. You need answers from a man who would rather keep them to himself.

sections.title: A Friendly Chat in Old Town
sections.body: In Old Town, your search for the missing diplomat leads among cutpurses and shady brokers, beyond the Cathedral's watchful eye. Dashel Stonefist is a local contact with ties to Stormwind's criminal factions, and he knows about the abduction. He has no wish to share what he knows with investigators asking sensitive questions.

sections.title: Brawl in the Alley
sections.body: Dashel Stonefist refuses to cooperate when you approach him. His loyal Old Town thugs back him as he tries to beat you down and end the investigation. Once you subdue Dashel and his men, he changes his tune and opens the way to the next lead in the conspiracy.

faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist is a shady local contact in Old Town with ties to Stormwind's criminal underworld. He knows more than he lets on about illicit movements through the city.

faq.q: Why do I have to fight Dashel instead of just talking to him?
faq.answer: Dashel has no interest in cooperating with investigators. When you ask about the missing diplomat, he assumes you can be easily intimidated and calls in his thugs to silence you. Only a sound thrashing convinces him to talk.

faq.q: Do I have to kill Dashel Stonefist?
faq.answer: No. You need to beat Dashel into submission, not kill him. When his health falls low enough, he yields, calls off his cronies, and agrees to answer your questions.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The fight takes place in the open in Old Town, near the alleys behind the Pig and Whistle tavern and local training halls where Dashel Stonefist usually hangs around.
Once you best Dashel, he apologizes and agrees to tell you what he knows about the conspiracy. He points the investigation toward the next link outside the capital.

faq.q: What is 'The Missing Diplomat' chain really about?
faq.answer: The search for a lost ambassador uncovers a web of deceit around the diplomat's abduction and the shadowy figures behind it.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you handle brutes like Dashel Stonefist when shaking down contacts for street-level intelligence.
As a human, you see Stormwind thugs hindering the search for the missing diplomat, a threat to the kingdom's security.
As an Alliance member, every lead on the diplomat's disappearance may expose the treachery threatening the leadership's stability.
